purpose: H13: A-C at separation 9 along x, at rest, T=4. Tests whether the C-on-A ratio falls with r like the A-A ratio (notebook H13). Pre-registered: under a shared distance factor (A-A ratio K(9)/K(5) = 0.65, lab-a), K_C(A) at 9 = -21.0 * 0.65 = -13.7 (+/-5%). A value more than 10% from -13.7 supports H13 (non-shared shape); within 5% does not reject the shared factor.
